title: polygala chinensis subvar. obovata
intro: Polygala chinensis subvar. obovata, commonly known as Chinese senega or Senega root, is a plant species belonging to the family Polygalaceae. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may help alleviate respiratory issues, improve immune function, and support the treatment of various infections. The therapeutic actions of Chinese senega include expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help relieve bronchitis, coughs, and asthma symptoms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include polygalasaponins, saponins, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
